premise: Bee visits every blossom on the old tree, and in autumn the tree shows her what she helped to grow.
inspiration: The Little Red Hen (folk), turned: the helper is not left out but thanked, and the harvest is the proof of her work.
lesson: Small, busy work can make something wonderful.
learning: Bees carry pollen from flower to flower, and that is how fruit begins

en-US.title: Bee and the Apple Blossom
en-US.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} In spring, the old tree {tree:glow #FFD1E0} was covered in pink blossoms. [excited] Bee buzzed from blossom to blossom, all day long. {sfx:buzz} Bzzz, bzzz. [curious] Why are your legs all yellow? asked the flower {flower:pulse}. Bee {bee:sparkle} looked down. It was fluffy yellow dust from the blossoms. It sticks to me, she said, and I carry it from flower to flower. Butterfly {butterfly:float loop 0.3} came to help. Bzzz, flutter, bzzz, all spring long. Then summer came, and the blossoms fell like pink snow. [sad] Oh, said Bee. They're gone. [softly] Wait and see, said the tree. And in autumn, where every blossom had been… [gasps] there was a round, red apple. {tree:wobble} [happily] You helped them grow, said the tree. And every apple on his branches was a thank-you. {bee:hearts}

es-ES.title: Abeja y las flores del manzano
es-ES.text: {bee:float loop 0.4} En primavera, el viejo árbol {tree:glow #FFD1E0} estaba cubierto de flores rosas. [excited] Abeja zumbaba de flor en flor, todo el día. {sfx:buzz} Bzzz, bzzz. [curious] ¿Por qué tienes las patas tan amarillas?, le preguntó la flor {flower:pulse}. Abeja {bee:sparkle} se miró. Era un polvito amarillo y suave de las flores. Se me pega, dijo, y lo llevo de flor en flor. Mariposa {butterfly:float loop 0.3} vino a ayudar. Bzzz, fru-fru, bzzz, toda la primavera. Luego llegó el verano, y las flores cayeron como nieve rosa. [sad] Oh, dijo Abeja. Ya no están. [softly] Espera y verás, dijo el árbol. Y en otoño, donde había estado cada flor… [gasps] había una manzana roja y redonda. {tree:wobble} [happily] Tú las has ayudado a crecer, dijo el árbol. Y cada manzana de sus ramas era un gracias. {bee:hearts}

buzz.prompt: a friendly honeybee buzzing from flower to flower
